title: Bridging vision language model (VLM) evaluation gaps with a framework for scalable and cost-effective benchmark generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Vision Language Models (VLMs) on technical perception tasks such as object counting, depth perception, and spatial relationship analysis. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The mention of ethical guidelines in the Impact Statement regarding human annotation does not constitute a core component of the benchmarking framework itself.
